description: qou-qb8g obstacle 1 made quantitative. The c_3 extractor c_3 = (Q_beta^exp/Q_N2(q) - 1)/u(q)^3 is an explicit function of q and CAN be evaluated at the bar-partner 1/q0, but Q_beta^exp is held fixed while q moves ~21%, so away from the anchor the numerator is O(1) rather than O(u^3) and the 1/u^3 inversion returns O(1e5). Measured: c_3^extr(q0) = -2.069, c_3^extr(1/q0) = -352600 (1.7e5x). The u shift itself is tame — u(1/q) = q^2 u(q) exactly — so the blow-up is entirely the fixed-Q_beta artifact. Consequently the extractor's 'bar-even part' is -176301, about 8.7e4 x Vol(4_1), and is not a bar split. Separately, (H1) c_3^even = -Vol(4_1) DEMANDS c_3(1/q0) = -2 Vol(4_1) - c_3(q0), an O(1) number. That demand is NOT new information — it equals the anchor datum transported by (H1) (the implied bar-odd part is identically S_leak(q0)) — so it must not be reported as an out-of-sample test. What is gained is methodological: a fibre carrier converges at 1/q0 and not at q0 (PR #5084), so at 1/q0 the carrier can be compared to (H1) without evaluating on the divergent side. The comparison becomes possible, not sharper. Arithmetic on committed values; no fit, no c_k wired.
tier: exact arithmetic on the committed extractor (no fit)

context.axis: qou-qb8g — c_3 bar-parity; the bar-partner evaluation point
context.companion: PR #5084 QOU.QBeta.HabiroEvaluationTrichotomy — a fibre carrier written as a q-series converges at 1/q0 < 1 and NOT at q0 > 1, so the bar-even combination cannot be formed from a single series. Domain obstruction, complementary to the numerical one here.
context.scope: Scope-(a) throughout. This does NOT refute (H1) — it shows the EXTRACTOR cannot test it at the bar-partner, and states what a fibre carrier must return there instead. No invariant is named forbidding a 4_1-volume ingredient in c_3's bar-even part.
